name: Burndown
author: kandown
description: Story points, card badges and a collapsible burndown panel. The canonical reference extension also exercises a Done gate and CLI command.

name: Labels
author: kandown
description: A select label field with emoji badges, plus a gate requiring a label before Done. Demonstrates select fields, badges and gate composition.

name: Webhook Sync
author: kandown
description: Fire a webhook when a task reaches Done. Demonstrates the sync contribution point and the net permission.
